prerequisites: No prerequisites. Knowledge from the 'Datenbanksysteme' module is recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students know and can apply distributed data management techniques.
Students know basic knowledge for working with NoSQL systems.
Students can use these systems in an application context.
Students can recognize differences between various NoSQL systems and relational systems.
Students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to distributed data processing such as Apache Spark
Overview of different types of NoSQL systems (e.g., Cassandra, MongoDB, ElasticSearch)

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercises
Written exam or oral exam (individual exam)

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercises and orally present the solution to at least two of the exercises. Grading is based on a written or oral examination, scored from 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science program.
bibliography: Dan Sullivan: NoSQL for Mere Mortals, Addison-Wesley Professional, 2015
